# A target declines a program it cannot express, at the line that asks for
# what it lacks, rather than emitting code its own compiler refuses
# (ir.Declined, design/testing.md).

# A js: function left for a Go build to call: called, or handed on as a value.
! sngl generate --lang=go --platform=bubbletea --out=bad js.sngl
stderr 'js.sngl:9:\d+: hello is js:./api''s, and a "go" build cannot call it at run time'
! sngl generate --lang=go --platform=bubbletea --out=bad jsvalue.sngl
stderr 'jsvalue.sngl:13:\d+: hello is js:./api''s, and a "go" build cannot call it at run time'
# html's handlers are JavaScript, whatever the language.
sngl generate --lang=go --platform=html --out=ok js.sngl

# A declaration marked as another language's, with no spelling in the build's.
! sngl generate --lang=go --platform=bubbletea --out=bad jsnative.sngl
stderr 'jsnative.sngl:10:\d+: btoa is js''s, and a "go" build cannot call it at run time'
# And a Go one, where html runs the page's script: all of it under any
# language but Go, and under Go what the page reads.
! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=bad gonative.sngl
stderr 'gonative.sngl:10:\d+: getpid is go''s, and a "none" build cannot call it at run time'
! sngl generate --lang=go --platform=html --out=bad gohost.sngl
stderr 'the page''s script names syscall, a Go package, and the page runs JavaScript'

# A go: import is not that: html.frontend compiles it to wasm and the page
# reaches it through the extern bridge, so no module import names it.
sngl generate --lang=go --platform=html --out=wasm wasm.sngl
stdout 'wasm/assets/wasm_exec\..*\.js'
grep '__sngl_externs' wasm/server.go
! grep 'from "example.com/declines/api"' wasm/server.go

# A C function, on a build whose handlers write no call to C.
! sngl generate --lang=kotlin --platform=android --out=bad c.sngl
stderr 'c.sngl:11:\d+: say is the C function say, and kotlin on android writes no call to C'
! sngl generate --lang=js --platform=html --out=bad c.sngl
stderr 'writes no call to C'

# Go holds cCalls: the same call is cgo, not a decline. The run-time check
# above leaves C to this capability rather than calling it another language.
sngl generate --lang=go --platform=bubbletea --out=cgo c.sngl
grep 'import "C"' cgo/model.go

# Another platform's package: a function, and a component.
! sngl generate --lang=go --platform=bubbletea --out=bad gtk.sngl
stderr 'gtk.sngl:5:\d+: quit is declared by sngl:platform/gtk4, and this build targets bubbletea'
! sngl generate --lang=go --platform=win32 --out=bad html.sngl
stderr 'html.sngl:5:\d+: component "html.div" has no win32 implementation'

# A call only the build answers, in a view whose loop the target runs: a static
# site answers it per page.
! sngl generate --lang=go --platform=bubbletea --out=bad md.sngl
stderr 'md.parse is answered only while the program builds'
stderr 'makes a view''s calls as the program runs, where a static site makes them per document'
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=ok md.sngl

# An intrinsic the language the call is written in has no implementation of.
! sngl generate --lang=c --platform=win32 --out=bad clock.sngl
stderr 'clock.sngl:8:\d+: intrinsic time.now has no c implementation'
! sngl generate --lang=c --platform=gtk4 --out=bad between.sngl
stderr 'between.sngl:8:\d+: intrinsic time.between has no c implementation'
# The Go build implements gRPC, and html's handlers are JavaScript.
! sngl generate --lang=go --platform=html --out=bad grpc.sngl
stderr 'grpc.sngl:15:\d+: intrinsic grpc.call has no js implementation'

-- clock.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import time "sngl:time"

var at = ""

ui.window {
    ui.button(text=at, @click {
        at = string(time.now() == time.now())
    })
}
-- between.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import time "sngl:time"

var a time.datetime = "2024-01-15T10:30:00+05:00"
var b time.datetime = "2024-01-15T10:31:00+05:00"

ui.window {
    ui.text(value=string(int(time.between(a, b) / 1s)))
}
-- grpc.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import grpc "sngl:grpc"
import ui "sngl:ui"

#[grpc.message("shop.Get")]
struct Get {
    #[grpc.field(1)]
    id int = 0
}

var title = "-"

ui.window {
    ui.button(text=title, @click {
        match var b = grpc.call[Get, Get](server="localhost:50051", method="/shop.Shop/Get", request={id=1}) {
            ok { title = "{b.id}" }
            failed { title = b.code }
        }
    })
}
-- api/index.ts --
export async function hello(name: string): Promise<string> { return "Hello " + name; }
-- js.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import api "js:./api"

var greeting = ""

ui.window {
    ui.text(value=greeting)
    ui.button(text="go", @click {
        greeting = api.hello("world")
    })
}
-- jsvalue.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import api "js:./api"

func run(f func(name string) string) string {
    return f("world")
}

var greeting = ""

ui.window {
    ui.text(value=greeting)
    ui.button(text="go", @click {
        greeting = run(api.hello)
    })
}
-- say.h --
void say(const char *s);
-- say.c --
#include <stdio.h>
#include "say.h"
void say(const char *s) { puts(s); }
-- jsnative.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import js "sngl:language/js"

#[js.native("btoa")]
func btoa(s string) string

var said = ""

ui.window {
    ui.button(text=said, @click { said = btoa("hi") })
}
-- gonative.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import go "sngl:language/go"

#[go.native("syscall", "syscall.Getpid")]
func getpid() int

var pid = 0

ui.window {
    ui.button(text="{pid}", @click { pid = getpid() })
}
-- gohost.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import go "sngl:language/go"

#[go.native("syscall", "syscall.ImplementsGetwd")]
const getwd bool

var shown = false

ui.window {
    ui.button(text="{shown}", @click { shown = getwd })
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/declines

go 1.23
-- api/api.go --
package api

func Double(n int) int { return n * 2 }
-- wasm.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:platform/html"
import "go:example.com/declines/api"

var n = 1

ui.window {
    ui.button(text="{n}", @click { n = html.frontend(api.Double(n)) })
}
-- c.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import c "sngl:x/c"

c.link(include="say.h", sources=["say.c", "say.h"])

#[c.native("say")]
func say(s string)

ui.window {
    ui.button(text="go", @click {
        say("hi")
    })
}
-- gtk.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import gtk4 "sngl:platform/gtk4"

ui.window {
    ui.button(text="go", @click { gtk4.quit() })
}
-- html.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import html "sngl:platform/html"

ui.window {
    html.div(innerText="hi")
}
-- md.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import md "sngl:ui/markup/md"

struct Doc {
    href string
    body string
}

const docs = [Doc{href="/a.html", body="# A"}, Doc{href="/b.html", body="# B"}]

ui.window(title=pages.current.title) {
    nav.stack #pages {
        for var d = docs {
            nav.page(href=d.href, title=d.href) {
                md.document(source=d.body)
            }
        }
    }
}
